{"guide": "Voice guide for Gareth Whitlow

Written by the offline stand in (fixed rules over the measured numbers). It is not a language model. Edit it freely.

Sentences: fairly long, about 17 words, with a clause or two. The rhythm jumps between very short and long lines.
Paragraphs: two or three sentences.
Tone: formal and measured. Avoid slang. Rarely uses contractions. Write the full words.
Talking to the reader: mostly describes things without addressing the reader. Rarely says I.
Questions and energy: seldom asks questions. Avoids exclamation marks.
Detail: uses few numbers.
Sentences most often start with a plain subject.
Favourite words: committee, review, organisations, where, every, dear, executive, yours, sincerely, gareth, whitlow, cost.
Phrases that keep coming back: yours sincerely; sincerely gareth; gareth whitlow; the board; during the.

Never invent facts, numbers or stories. If a line needs a real example, leave a bracket for the author."}
